title: lophotocarpus calycinus var. spongiosus

It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may also contribute to its use in treating wounds and infections.
